<function name="StartActivity" parent="NextBot" type="classfunc">
	<description>Start doing an activity (animation).

This function may not produce the desired result if <page>Entity:SetModel</page> has not yet been called on the nextbot entity</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="activity" type="number">One of the <page>Enums/ACT</page></arg>
	</args>
</function>
